verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is itself a built-in AI assistant with first-party agents. Its docs cite AI Agents, custom agent skills, web scraping and search, agent flows, and automatic meeting transcription and summarization, so users can hand tasks to it inside the product. Most of this evidence is headline-level, and community comments praise chat and setup but never describe delegating tasks to agents. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what tasks the agent can autonomously perform, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: A private AI assistant that runs entirely on your computer.
Chat with your docs, use AI Agents, hyper-configurable, multi-user, & no frustrating setup required.
Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
Automatically transcribes and summarizes any meeting entirely on your computer. Action items, key decisions, and full transcripts ready the moment you hang up.
